ITEM 1 | Sliced green bell pepper strips, bright green with slightly glossy skin, thin flat strips about 1 cm wide and 6-8 cm long, some curled at edges, scattered across the lower-left part of the plate, firm and slightly moist | 60
ITEM 2 | Cubed roasted potato pieces, golden-brown with crisp browned edges and some darker char spots, chunks about 2-3 cm, a few with herb flecks, dry-looking surface, along the right side of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Pale pink-brown meat chunks, fibrous and shredded texture, some pieces with darker seared edges, moderately moist with a little sheen, forming a cluster of about 4-5 cm pieces in the center and upper area | 110
ITEM 4 | Shredded herb-flecked meat mixture, grayish-brown with visible green herb bits and fine dark specks, slightly moist and clumping, sitting on and beside the meat pieces in the center-right of the plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Small green herb leaves, dark green and flat, scattered among the meat and potato pieces, a few leaves only | 3
